description: Derived, not a transcription: no premise has the conclusion as its consequent, and the countermodels needsReducedByBeingInAct, needsNoSelfMotion and needsActualMoverPrior in the Comparator config show that each premise is needed. A conditional refutation of the Night cosmogony's bundle resting on three open premises, one of them an unattributed bridge; it leaves the bare rival STMT-POTENCY-PRIOR-TO-ACT standing (rivalSurvivesCore). No refutes relation is recorded (#391) and it closes no premise.
